text:
```yaml
name: Auto Assign Milestone
on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - edited
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - edited

jobs:
  assign-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

      - name: Install policy-bot
        run: |
          dotnet tool install --global Microsoft.Git.CredentialManager.Core
          dotnet tool update --global Microsoft.Git.CredentialManager.Core

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Run policy-bot
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the target branch
          TARGET_BRANCH="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}"
          
          # Determine milestone based on target branch
          MILESTONE=""
          if [[ "$TARGET_BRANCH" == "main" ]]; then
            MILESTONE="9.5"
          elif [[ "$TARGET_BRANCH" == "release/9.4" ]]; then
            MILESTONE="9.4.1"
          fi
          
          # Only proceed if we have a milestone to assign
          if [[ -n "$MILESTONE" ]]; then
            # Use gh CLI to assign milestone
            echo "Assigning milestone '$MILESTONE' to PR #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
            
            # Check if milestone exists
            if gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/milestones --jq ".[].title" | grep -q "^$MILESTONE$"; then
              gh pr edit ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --add-milestone "$MILESTONE"
            else
              echo "Milestone '$MILESTONE' not found, skipping assignment"
            fi
          fi
```
